name: e2e-monorepo
description: An open framework for agentic end-to-end testing

scripts.build: pnpm --filter e2e run build && pnpm --filter @e2edev/web run build && pnpm --filter @e2edev/mobile run build && pnpm --filter @e2edev/github run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check-errors && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.release: pnpm run build && changeset publish --tag beta
scripts.canary: node scripts/canary-changeset.ts && changeset version --snapshot canary && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter e2e run test && pnpm --filter @e2edev/web run test && pnpm --filter @e2edev/mobile run test && pnpm --filter @e2edev/github run test
